pflege_kat-motif.en:
Push light figures with a ground spike into loose soil or lawn; in hard ground, pre-pierce a hole with a stick first so the spike doesn't break. Free-standing figures need a level, firm surface. Lay the lead cable so nobody trips over it, ideally along the edge of a flower bed.
Clean with a damp cloth after unplugging or switching off. After the season, store the figures dry and frost-free, ideally in the original packaging.
Whether the figure can stand outdoors is listed in the Technical details under Protection rating.
